market_free.prompt: Photoreal live-action Tang Dynasty night market, one uninterrupted wide shot, camera remains bolted to a tripod. The two full-length women in pink and sea-green robes on the left are already in motion at the opening. Their bodies shift visibly and their long sleeves sweep outward. Across the road the man in dark blue walks past the red-robed shopper, who turns to look. A breeze lifts and drops the free hem of the cream canvas awning at far left; the tassels under the right eaves swing a beat later. Pedestrians farther away walk through the festival. Preserve the scale and positions of the buildings, the open central road and the warm amber exposure of the reference. Natural footsteps, fabric rustle, subdued indistinct market chatter. No music, text, UI, cuts, whip pans or zoom.
